assets.title: Limestone house — compressed runtime model
assets.author: The Season contributors
assets.changes: Original Blender house and 11 painted colour textures preserved. Added a subtle original procedural limestone normal map, then pruned, deduplicated, resampled and compressed geometry with meshopt; colour textures use ETC1S KTX2 and the normal map uses UASTC KTX2. Raw input retained in art/source/house-painted.glb.

assets.title: Qwantani (Pure Sky)
assets.author: Greg Zaal (original photography); Jarod Guest (sky edits)
assets.changes: Official 1K HDR converted with Babylon.js 9.30.0 into a 256px prefiltered cubemap: nine specular mip levels encoded as PNG RGBD, plus diffuse spherical polynomial data. No exposure, tint or rotation baked in. Raw HDR and conversion record retained under art/vendor/polyhaven/qwantani-puresky/.
assets.notes: The official asset and Poly Haven licence pages declare CC0. The direct HDR download supplied no separate licence file; License.txt retains that source declaration and the complete CC0 legal text.
